## Round 329 — Gating theory, transient experts, librarian robots, expansion (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: mixture-of-experts for continual
learning — the trunk+experts architecture DTR part (i) sketches.

- **MoE theory [arXiv:2406.16437 (Li; vs no hits)].** First
  theoretical characterization: the gating network sparsifies and
  DISTRIBUTES diverse tasks among experts. → When/why the trunk+
  experts works, in principle. Design guidance for part (i).
- **Isolate-vs-share tradeoff [arXiv:2605.20247 (Liu / CP-MoE;
  vs no hits)].** The fundamental tradeoff: isolate experts (no
  transfer) vs share updates (forgetting); transient expert
  captures early task signal as middle path. → Our program lives
  inside this tradeoff (static arms = isolated; transplant =
  shared). CP-MoE's transient expert is a specified middle path
  worth stealing at design time.
- **Librarian robots [arXiv:2506.05985 (Lei; vs no hits)].**
  Lifelong ROBOT learning: progressive PEFT expert library, NO
  test-time task identifier needed, knowledge sharing among
  adapters. → Weakens the task-ID requirement (routing without
  labels — with TAME/Hafez, three votes for infer-not-given).
  Embodied + DTR-direct.
- **Self-controlled expansion [arXiv:2504.10561 (Wu; vs no hits)].**
  Static backbones fail diverse domains (inactive parameters);
  SELF-CONTROLLED dynamic EXPANSION grows the model. → Growth as
  a revision channel (capacity, not weights): genuinely new
  (nothing in 14 lines grows anything — all dims fixed). Parked
  architectural (needs dynamic capacity = substrate work,
  DTR-adjacent).

## Round 332 — Skill policies, curricula, stepping stones, rethinking (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: order/curriculum — does SEQUENCE
shape transfer? (Our chains fix H0→H1→H2; never varied.)

- **Skill parameters [arXiv:2110.10255 (Zentner; vs no hits)].**
  Store knowledge ONLY as learned skill policies (+ careful
  pre-training). → Transplant analog: our weights ARE the carried
  policies; our train leg IS the pre-training. Precedent that the
  carrier (not the schedule) is the design object.
- **Curriculum composition [arXiv:2605.23067 (He; vs no hits)].**
  Fixed architecture/algo/hyperparams; ONLY the training
  curriculum varies (in/mixed/out-of-domain) — composition shapes
  memory-agent skills. → Order/composition matters for memory.
  Our fixed order is an unexamined choice — but testing orders
  spends banks mapping the wound (6th axis; diminishing returns
  ruled). NOTED, not licensed, not parked.
- **Stepping stones [arXiv:2402.16681 (Liu / W-MPOT; vs no
  hits)].** Transfer curriculum over source+intermediate domains
  (Wasserstein-ordered); domain ordering + error accumulation
  rigorously addressed. → Our T1→T2 chains ARE intermediates;
  distance-ordered curricula untested. Same ruling: mapping, not
  licensed, not parked.
- **Rethinking [arXiv:1907.01929 (Parisi; vs no hits)].**
  CL for autonomous agents/robots: rich learning capabilities for
  uncertain streams; interference framing. → Framing affinity
  (agents, interference); no mechanism to lift.

Ruling (program): order/curriculum studies characterize the wound;
characterization is closed (5 axes + diminishing returns). These
papers are precedents for the record, not candidates — nothing
here clears the C15 bar (same task/gap/channel, would-be mapping).

## Round 335 — Task-conditioned, masked, partial, dependency-aware (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: hypernetworks — the trunk design
DTR part (i) needs, in the literature's own words.

- **Canonical trunk [arXiv:1906.00695 (von Oswald; vs no hits)].**
  Task-conditioned hypernetwork GENERATES target weights; rehearse
  weight realizations (regularized), not data. → THE reference
  design for part (i): trunk = hypernetwork, task index in,
  weights out. Banked as the design to beat/adapt.
- **Generated masks [arXiv:2310.00113 (HyperMask; vs no hits)].**
  Hypernetwork generates MASKS (lottery tickets), fixing the
  "completely different architectures per task" failure. → Merges
  the SU thread with the trunk thread: our per-tick mask could one
  day be trunk-generated per-task. Conditional on the trunk.
- **How much task-specific [arXiv:2306.10724 (Partial; vs no
  hits)].** Generate ONLY final layers, freeze initial; answers
  how many layers can stay frozen. → Sizing principle for part
  (i): shared chemotaxis trunk + small task heads (don't generate
  everything). Directly applicable at design time.
- **Structure matters [arXiv:2209.07712 (Dependency-preserving; vs
  no hits)].** Weights aren't independent across layers;
  dependency-aware generation. → Our weights are niche models
  (structured, 1-NN 1.000) — generation must respect that
  structure, not emit flat vectors. Constraint banked.

## Round 348 — Sequential, prototypes, taxonomy, inputs (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: test-time adaptation — adapting
DURING transfer, not before it. (A memorized ID for the original
TTT paper fetched wrong — verifying before claiming, per discipline;
dropped, not mapped.)

- **Sequential TTT [arXiv:2303.10856 (Su; vs no hits)].**
  Realistic sequential test-time training: instant inference on
  the target WHILE adapting, no source data. → Names our transfer
  setting exactly (T1/T2 ARE sequential inference+adaptation).
  Our loop never fires there (C13 fired twice on H0; test-time
  firing was killed as schedule — this reframes it as PROTOCOL,
  not schedule, but the bar ruling stands: same channel).
- **Prototype adaptation [arXiv:2604.15494 (ProtoTTA; vs no
  hits)].** Interpretable prototype representations adapted at
  test time (not just weights/statistics). → Our weights ARE niche
  models (prototype-like, 1-NN 1.000) — prototype-TTA maps onto
  them: adapt the niche models at test time. Unlicensed (needs a
  prototype-update rule we don't have), but the closest TTA analog
  to our substrate on record.
- **TTA taxonomy [arXiv:2303.15361 (Liang survey; vs no hits)].**
  Adapt pre-trained models to unlabeled test data before inference;
  weight/statistics vs input adaptation. → Taxonomy for the
  transfer-side search (TRANSFER_MAP's "third mechanism" hunt
  gains a map: weight-side (tried: gains/masks/scales) vs
  input-side (untried)).
- **Input-side adaptation [arXiv:2406.04295 (Guo; vs no hits)].**
  Diffusion-driven TTA adapts INPUTS (transform target toward
  source) instead of weights. → New LOCUS: neither replay nor
  transplant touches inputs — all our mechanisms are weight-side.
  Unlicensed (needs a generative model of the train world), but
  the first idea in 30+ rounds that sits OUTSIDE the weight locus.
  Filed for the transfer-side hunt (TRANSFER_MAP addendum next
  program turn).

## Round 350 — Growing, compressing, contextualizing, isometry (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: growth + plasticity geometry — the
architectural candidate's literature and a measurable mechanism.

- **Growing preserves plasticity [arXiv:2608.01475 (Kong; vs no
  hits)].** Growing AND elastic nets in ONLINE CL (like animals);
  incremental random units preserve plasticity (beyond just
  beating forgetting). → Candidate 7's closest literature: grow
  for plasticity, not only capacity. Growth = plasticity
  mechanism, which reframes it from "bigger substrate" to "live
  substrate" — stronger rationale, still parked (needs dynamic
  capacity).
- **Progress & Compress [arXiv:1805.06370 (Schwarz; vs no hits)].**
  Active column learns the task, distills into knowledge base;
  constant params; ACCELERATES subsequent learning. → Forward
  transfer BY CONSTRUCTION (later tasks learn faster) = the
  productivity analog (VISION requirement b) in architectural
  form. Design precedent for any DTR trunk (active/trunk split).
- **Progressive contextualization [arXiv:2209.00347 (Zhang /
  DaCoRL; vs no hits)].** Cluster stationary tasks into contexts
  incrementally; expandable multihead policy; continual RL. →
  Context-clustering + expansion together (TAME's shift-detection
  + Wu's growth in one system). Precedent stack for part (i).
- **Dynamical isometry [arXiv:2606.09762 (Rosseau; vs no hits)].**
  Plasticity ↔ empirical NTK; dynamical isometry (Jacobian
  singular values ≈ 1) preserves plasticity; compatible with
  expressivity. → Geometry mechanism for our LoP story (with
  Grieco's σ). FLAGGED AS MEASURABLE: readout Jacobian spectra
  are computable read-only from stored weights — a licensed
  zero-worlds measurement (like compatibility V1) whenever
  specified. Not specified yet; recorded.

## Round 353 — Prototype-augmented, variational, steered, shortcut (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),
all virgin pre-append. Themed: prototypes — the interpretable
middle layer between weights and tasks.

- **Prototype-augmented hypernetwork [arXiv:2505.07450 (De La
  Fuente / PAH; vs no hits)].** Single hypernetwork conditioned
  on learnable TASK PROTOTYPES generates task heads on demand;
  dual distillation (logits + prototypes) stabilizes features.
  → The most complete DTR part-(i) template yet: trunk +
  prototype-index + generated heads + distillation. Filed as the
  design to beat (with von Oswald/TAME).
- **Variational prototypes [arXiv:1905.09447 (Zhang; vs no
  hits)].** Prototypes as distributions (means + variances),
  few-shot CL, consolidate + recall. → Prototypes with
  uncertainty; recallable. Compatible with PAH (distributional
  indices).
- **Steered prototypes [arXiv:2303.09447 (Li / CPP; vs no hits)].**
  Task-specific prompt-tuning steers prototypes (contrastive);
  fixes semantic DRIFT + INTERFERENCE, rehearsal-free, +4–6%.
  → Names our wound's cousins (drift, interference) with a
  steering solution that needs no replay. Unlicensed (needs
  prototype space we don't have).
- **Shortcut limit [arXiv:2308.00301 (Wei; vs no hits)].**
  SHORTCUT learning is the key limiter of online CL (features
  that don't generalize). → New lens on OUR wound: avoidance may
  key on spurious cue correlations that flip across codebooks
  (not extinction failure but shortcut failure). Lens only —
  possible future measurement (per-cue turn dominance exists in
  CONTACT_GRADIENT work); not a line, not a claim.

## Round 359 — Unified, collapsed, robust, uneroded (live arXiv; 2026-11-02)

Four fresh abstracts (fetched 2026-11-02, abstracts only, 0 worlds),

  CONTINUAL unlearning degrades the ability to forget itself

- **Robust unlearning [arXiv:2601.21682 (Xu / FIT; vs no hits)].**
  Processes deletion streams while resisting forgetting AND

  the unlearning; the mirror of our retention question.
- **Uneroded unlearning [arXiv:2503.13769 (Thakral / DUGE; vs no
  hits)].** Removes targeted concepts while preserving related
  ones, no generalization erosion. → Selective removal preserving
  neighbors — the surgical ideal. Unlicensed.

## Round 776 — LIVE via OpenAlex (arXiv API still down): soft-winners, routers, specializers, goedels (Kang WSN 2023, Hongbo Li MoE-theory 2024, Junzhuo Li DES-MoE 2025, Yin Goedel Agent 2024; 2026-11-02)

Recovery: arXiv export API still returns 14-byte empties; switched to
api.openalex.org (different host, reachable) for search + abstracts.
Abstracts only, 0 worlds. (Numbering: R776 breaks the odd=live
parity convention — sequence integrity kept over parity; content is
live.) Four papers, all virgin pre-append (0 hits each).

- **Soft-winning subnetworks [Kang et al. 2023, Forget-free Continual
  Learning with Soft-Winning SubNetworks; vs no hits].** → SoftNet's
  non-binary task-adaptive masks (immune to forgetting because each
  subnetwork does not infringe the others; winning tickets reuse prior
  weights) is the run attempt (B2's per-regime experts are the same
  bet — separation by regime, not by task); the audit it sharpens: B2's
  branches share the feature vector, so infringement, if it lives
  anywhere, lives in the shared input — a future probe should test
  cross-branch interference directly.
- **MoE continual-learning theory [Hongbo Li et al. 2024, Theory on
  Mixture-of-Experts in Continual Learning; vs no hits].** → The
  router-learns-to-select / experts-specialize theorem is the kept
  verdict (B2's hard viability switch is a FIXED router — the theory's
  gap, router learning, is exactly what B2 does not do); a learned
  router (B4-shaped) is recorded as a CANDIDATE rationale, not a
  license — it needs its own genuinely-new case under the C17-bar
  discipline.
- **Dynamic expert specialization [Junzhuo Li et al. 2025, DES-MoE;
  vs no hits].** → Adaptive router + expert-domain correlation mapping
  + progressive freezing (matches single-domain ESFT on six domains)
  is the (unclaimed) claim — the analogy that disciplines B2:
  progressive freezing is the program's freeze probes, expert-domain
  mapping is per-regime experts, and DES's bar (match the specialist)
  is B2's bar (beat the guard that internalizes the stop).
- **Goedel Agent [Yin et al. 2024, self-referential recursively
  self-improving agent; vs no hits].** → LLM-rewritten own-logic
  without fixed routines is the joined vote — and the program's
  in-agent loop is the bounded, checkpointed, budgeted version of
  exactly this ambition (VISION milestone 3 verbatim); what Goedel
  lacks (independent evaluation + compute budgets) is what the
  frozen-plan/single-attempt discipline supplies.
## Round 777 — LIVE via OpenAlex: stablers, distrallers, diffusers, metarsis (StableMoE 2022, Distral, Diffusion-QL 2022, MetaRSI 2026; 2026-11-02)

Live via api.openalex.org (arXiv API still down). Abstracts only,
0 worlds. All four virgin pre-append (StableMoE/Distral/Diffusion
Policies 0 hits; Darwin/Red-Queen/Mendel Goedel variants already
mapped — routed to MetaRSI instead).

- **Stable routing [Dai et al. 2022, StableMoE; vs no hits].** →
  Routing fluctuation (same input updates different experts, only one
  used at inference) harms sample efficiency; two stages: learn a
  balanced routing, distill it into a lightweight router, FREEZE it.
  The program's fixed viability router avoids fluctuation by
  construction — a feature bought at the MoE-theory round's price
  (no router learning); and distill-then-freeze is the frozen-plan
  discipline in miniature (decide the routing, then freeze it).
- **Distill-and-transfer [Teh et al., Distral; vs no hits].** →
  Task gradients interfere negatively through shared parameters and
  differing reward schemes let one task dominate; answer: share a
  DISTILLED policy, not parameters. This is the R3/R4 failure in
  miniature (shared weights + A-vs-BCD reward regimes) — and the
  program holds a concrete embodied negative against Distral's
  prescription (R4's BC-of-guarded lost 0/8 by −0.57): distillation
  without the right substrate is another dead level, recorded.
- **Expressive policies [Wang et al. 2022, Diffusion-QL; vs no
  hits].** → Offline RL fails under limited-expressiveness policy
  classes; represent the policy as a conditional diffusion model +
  action-value maximization. Outside support for the go-quality side:
  every odor round used linear heads, so if the gap is go-quality,
  expressiveness is the untested axis — B3's fresh rationale, if any,
  must be expressiveness, never another gate.
- **Meta-RSI [Tan et al. 2026, MetaRSI/RSI2; vs no hits].** → RSI
  validated only on machine-checkable slices (code/math), bound to
  format not capability; must operate across real domains where
  correctness is settled by argument, replication, measurement. The
  program's discipline IS this demand in one domain: frozen plans
  (argument), single attempts (replication), negative preservation
  (measurement) — and "claim RSI only on separately-satisfying
  evidence" is MetaRSI's format-bound critique turned into a rule.
## Round 778 — LIVE via OpenAlex: balancers, preferrers, dopamines, benchers (Loss-Free 2024, Kumar-vs-BC 2022, Landayan fly-foraging 2018, RSIBench-Data 2026; 2026-11-02)

Live via api.openalex.org (arXiv API still down). Abstracts only,

- **Loss-free balancing [Wang et al. 2024, Auxiliary-Loss-Free Load
  Balancing for MoE; vs no hits].** → Unbalanced load collapses
  routing; aux losses fix balance but inject interference gradients
  that impair the model; answer: expert-wise bias updated by recent
  load, no aux gradients. B4 fuel with a warning label: if the
  program ever learns a router, balance it by load-bias, never by
  aux-loss — aux gradients would swamp the tiny steering head the
  way they impair the big one.
- **Offline-RL-vs-BC [Kumar et al. 2022, When Should We Prefer
  Offline RL Over Behavioral Cloning?; vs no hits].** → Characterizes
  the environments where offline RL beats BC on equal expert data
  (BC cannot improve over its demonstrator's suboptimality
  structure). Adjudicates R4 from outside: guarded's demonstrations
  carry exactly the suboptimality structure BC cannot transcend —
  R4's 0/8 is an instance of a characterized phenomenon, not a
  surprise, and the characterization predicts which future
  teacher-data COULD work (data the student can improve upon, not
  merely imitate).
- **State-dependent foraging circuits [Landayan et al. 2018,
  satiation dopaminergic control of foraging in Drosophila; vs no
  hits].** → Food-deprived vs well-fed flies use DISTINCT
  dopaminergic circuits (PAM vs other) that CONVERGE on D1 Kenyon
  cells, where activity promotes foraging independent of satiation.
  Biology's viability gate is per-regime experts — nature's B2 —
  with the detail B2 lacked: the circuits converge on shared
  downstream integration rather than independent argmax. Any future
  mixture needs the convergence point, not just the branches.
- **RSI data-bench [Meng et al. 2026, RSIBench-Data; vs no hits].**
  → Fixed post-training stack, Harbor/E2B official evaluation,
  fixed budgets across agents, iterative training-data revision.
  The benchmark version of the program's discipline: frozen plan =
  fixed stack, op caps = fixed budgets, propose-evaluate-adopt =
  iterative revision. Outside convergence on the discipline shape —
  the field is standardizing what the program already practices.
## Round 779 — LIVE via OpenAlex: censors, tinies, rovers, trusters (CTPS 2026, tiny-RNN 2025, foraging-gene 2009, benchmarks-review 2025; 2026-11-02)

Live via api.openalex.org (arXiv API still down). Abstracts only,
0 worlds. All four virgin pre-append (0 hits each).

- **Censoring-aware shaping [Pan et al. 2026, CTPS; vs no hits].**
  → Sparse reward + time-limited episodes: absence of observed
  success is incomplete follow-up, not failure — model it as
  right-censored time-to-event data or progress estimates bias.
  Measurement insight for the whole program: dead flies are
  right-censored trajectories, and no verdict gate models
  censoring — deaths currently read as failures. Future probe
  design should treat death as censoring (survival analysis),
  not as zero.
- **Tiny recurrent strategies [Li et al. 2025, discovering
  cognitive strategies with tiny RNNs; vs no hits].** → 1–4 unit
  RNNs outperform classical cognitive models and match larger nets
  across six reward-learning tasks; interpreted via dynamical
  systems. B3 upgraded: expressiveness lives in recurrence and
  dynamics, not width — a 1–4 unit RECURRENT steering head could
  express the viability-gated strategy linear heads cannot, at
  billable size, interpretable the same way. Recorded as the B3
  refinement (recurrent, not MLP).
- **Rover/sitter dial [Kent et al. 2009, foraging-gene GEI under
  deprivation; vs no hits].** → One natural gene variant retunes
  the whole deprivation response (fat, carbs, food-leaving,
  expression) via insulin-pathway interaction. The viability
  channel is the program's analog dial — and every round says the
  failures are in the architecture AROUND the dial, never the dial
  itself. Keep the signal, change the consumer: consistent with
  the recurrent-B3 direction.
- **Benchmark trust [Eriksson et al. 2025, interdisciplinary
  review of ~110 evaluation-shortcoming studies; vs no hits].** →
  Contamination, inadequate documentation, signal-vs-noise
